text_block_list.text:

training session!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:

your guidance as her trainer is truly 
something to behold.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Both your earnest posture and that

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... got a little too fired up there! 
I'm expecting great things from you. Catch 
ya later!
